hypothesis: The M155 capability-belief auxiliary signal can be kept only if the update is made explicitly safe for the protected rollout key and margin surface before any strict miner or PPO promotion.
success_criteria: preserve the P0 human-view actor input contract
retain positive validation target and pairwise delta improvements on the M151 capability-belief dataset
pass the protected critical-key replay for 9944|perturbed|28|28
keep behavior seed 9503 aggregate success within the M154 prescreen tolerance versus M142 alpha_0_4
document whether the repair is admitted to a full M154 gate repeat or rejected
failure_criteria: objective loss improves only by breaking behavior retention
repair relies on hidden diagnostics or oracle inputs at actor inference
repair proceeds to PPO before the cheap gate passes

commands.name: m156_key_safe_capability_belief_repair
commands.command: Design and run a key-safe variant of the M155 auxiliary candidate that includes protected-key or rollout-margin retention before repeating the M155 cheap behavior and critical-key prescreens.

decision_rule: Do not run strict miners or PPO unless a repaired candidate keeps the M155 capability-belief objective signal and passes the M141/M142 protected-key replay.
notes: M155 showed that fixed capability loss and feature anchoring are not rollout-key safe.
The first repair should be small and cheap-gated, not a broad PPO continuation.
